snippet.title: Dungeon of the Forgotten King - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Ever since the first conceptual demo, we've been working on the next stage of DotFK. We're quite happy to announce this major update to the project.
Here, you guys will be able to check new visuals, new mechanics, and a whole lot of enemies with their own set of moves.
If the RNG isn't cutting it, you can always use the soul gems you adquire on every character run on the Eternal Store.

You can try the demo on Steam, and if you do... may the RNG Gods be with you!
Demo➡️https://store.steampowered.com/app/770760/Dungeon_of_the_Forgotten_King/
- CGS Team
